transcript_only_text:
Throughout  my  history  as  a  business 
 owner,  I've  had  four  periods  where  I  had 
 tremendous  growth.  And  in  each  of  those 
 periods,  it's  where  I  was  making  more 
 than  two  to  three  times  what  it  cost  me 
 to  both  acquire  and  deliver  for  two 
 customers  in  the  first  30  days.  And  so, 
 what  that  means  is  if  I  pay  to  get  a 
 customer,  and  then  that  customer  comes 
 pre-loaded  with  the  cash  to  deliver  for 
 him  and  get  another  customer  and  deliver 
 for  that  customer,  then  cash  no  longer 
 is  a  constraint  in  the  business,  which 
 means  that  I  can  pretty  much  just  crank 
 the  advertising  until  something  else 
 breaks  in  my  business.
